record.product_family: Wyatt Technology DynaPro Plate Reader III
record.manual_scope: Model-specific Harvard CMI DLS getting-started operating guide, 8 pages, reviewed for plate handling, acquisition, analysis and shutdown. Laboratory procedures and recommended settings apply to the documented setup.
record.related_material_types: Metal nanoparticles;Metal-oxide nanoparticles;Silica nanoparticles;Semiconductor nanocrystals;Polymeric nanoparticles;Lipid nanoparticles and liposomes;Carbon nanomaterials
record.related_process_types: Microemulsion / reverse-micelle synthesis;Surface modification and functionalization;Nanoscale self-assembly;Biological / biosystem-assisted synthesis;Microfluidic nanoprecipitation of polymeric nanoparticles
record.association_basis: Capability association for DLS characterization of compatible liquid dispersions, including final samples from these routes. The sample, solvent and plate must support the documented optical method.
record.notes: DLS and SLS microplate analyzer for liquid dispersions. Capacity is 96, 384 or 1536 wells. The 4 µL minimum is a sample-dependent 1536-well specification. DLS reports hydrodynamic radius. SLS mass interpretation requires appropriate calibration and concentration data. Supplier offers describe used configurations with different software versions. A newer DynaPro Plate Reader 4 generation is listed by Wyatt.
record.image_scope: American Laboratory Trading photograph of the exact DynaPro Plate Reader III. The label is visible. Linked source media retains supplier rights and branding.
record.product_page_scope: Current DynaPro plate-reader family page. Exact III-generation specifications are in the linked W3400C brochure.

io.inputs_and_states: Liquid nanoparticle or macromolecule dispersions in a supported optical-bottom 96-, 384- or 1536-well plate. Select wells, plate type, replicates, acquisition duration, laser attenuation and temperature method in DYNAMICS. Supply solvent properties and concentration/calibration data for the chosen analysis. Electrical power and an Ethernet-connected computer support acquisition. A dry nitrogen purge supports low-temperature operation.
io.outputs_and_states: Scattered-light correlation and size-distribution data with hydrodynamic radius and polydispersity. SLS analysis can report molar mass with suitable concentration and calibration data. Records include temperature, well images and exported results. The sample remains in the plate after optical measurement.
io.units_of_measure: nm (hydrodynamic radius, 0.5–1,000 nm), Da or kDa (SLS molar mass, 1–1,000 kDa), °C (temperature, 4–85 °C under the specified conditions), s (acquisition time), µL (sample volume), mg/mL or µg/mL (sample concentration), % (laser power and relative size distributions).
